verdict.rationale: The pack shows that Meta publishes a model card and use policy for every Llama family, but no quoted vendor text describes what the models are bad at, their limitations, or their failure modes. The weaknesses that do appear (non-English refusals, guardrails sidestepped by prefilling, an 8k context window) come only from community reports, not vendor docs. Llama Guard and Prompt Guard are safety-filter products, an adjacent feature rather than documentation of the model's own jagged edges.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents the model's failure modes and jagged edges — what it is bad at, in its own docs, not just what it aces
